# Cameo — account brief

## Who
Cameo sells personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities ([source](https://cameo.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo)), and the homepage links a careers page ([source](https://cameo.com/careers)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 31 public repos and 240 followers ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).
- cameo/cameo-app was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)).
- The App Store listing has 95,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- There were 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@cameo-maintainer-1), 203 commits, top contributor to cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "Remote", website https://cameo.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Cameo. Maintains the Cameo app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@cameo-maintainer-2), 151 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "New York, NY", website https://cameo.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Cameo mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Cameo app." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@cameo-maintainer-3), 77 commits ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Cameo", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://cameo.com, and bio "Engineer at Cameo. Mostly the Cameo app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3))

## Why now
Cameo shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)), and cameo/cameo-app was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Cameo app on Expo and React Native ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)), and you have 203 commits to cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). The repo carries an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside its own CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app went out 4 times on the App Store in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). Across those four releases, how much of the build and submit path runs through EAS versus the workflows you maintain in the repo?
